scripts.build: node tools/build/clean-dist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && node tools/build/esbuild.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && pnpm run lint:deps && pnpm run lint:css && node tools/build/copy-static.mjs && node tools/build/generate-asset-manifest.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:e2e && pnpm run test:e2e:embedded
scripts.test:e2e: PLAYWRIGHT_USE_DOCKER=1 pnpm run build && playwright test --project=chromium
scripts.test:e2e:firefox: PLAYWRIGHT_USE_DOCKER=1 pnpm run build && playwright test --project=firefox
scripts.test:e2e:embedded: PLAYWRIGHT_USE_DOCKER=1 SERVER_STATIC_MODE=embedded bash -lc 'pnpm run build && playwright test tests/embedded-static.spec.ts --project=chromium'
